```lean
import Mathlib

open Finset

/-- The classical bound `∑_{i=1}^n 1/i² ≤ 2 - 1/n` for `n ≥ 1`. -/
theorem h03_invsq_sum (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ∑ i ∈ Icc 1 n, (1 : ℝ) / (i : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 2 - 1 / (n : ℝ) := by
  -- an auxiliary statement proved by induction on `m = n-1`
  have aux :
      ∀ m : ℕ,
        (∑ i ∈ Icc 1 (m + 1), (1 : ℝ) / (i : ℝ) ^ 2) ≤ 2 - (1 : ℝ) / (m + 1) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
        simp
    | succ m ih =>
        -- key inequality: 1/(m+2)² ≤ 1/(m+1) - 1/(m+2)
        have hterm :
            (1 : ℝ) / ((m + 2 : ℝ) ^ 2) ≤ (1 : ℝ) / (m + 1) - (1 : ℝ) / (m + 2) := by
          have hpos1 : (0 : ℝ) < (m + 1 : ℝ) := by
            have : (0 : ℕ) < m + 1 := Nat.succ_pos _
            exact_mod_cast this
          have hpos2 : (0 : ℝ) < (m + 2 : ℝ) := by linarith
          field_simp [pow_two, hpos1.ne', hpos2.ne'] ; nlinarith
        calc
          (∑ i ∈ Icc 1 (m + 2), (1 : ℝ) / (i : ℝ) ^ 2)
              = (∑ i ∈ Icc 1 (m + 1), (1 : ℝ) / (i : ℝ) ^ 2) +
                (1 : ℝ) / ((m + 2 : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
                simpa using
                  (Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (a := 1) (b := m + 1)
                    (f := fun i : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / (i : ℝ) ^ 2))
          _ ≤ (∑ i ∈ Icc 1 (m + 1), (1 : ℝ) / (i : ℝ) ^ 2) +
                ((1 : ℝ) / (m + 1) - (1 : ℝ) / (m + 2)) :=
                add_le_add_left hterm _
          _ ≤ (2 - (1 : ℝ) / (m + 1)) +
                ((1 : ℝ) / (m + 1) - (1 : ℝ) / (m + 2)) :=
                add_le_add_right ih _
          _ = 2 - (1 : ℝ) / (m + 2) := by ring
  -- use the auxiliary result, handling the case `n = 0` (which cannot happen)
  cases n with
  | zero => cases (Nat.not_succ_le_self 0 hn)
  | succ m =>
      have : (∑ i ∈ Icc 1 (m + 1), (1 : ℝ) / (i : ℝ) ^ 2) ≤
            2 - (1 : ℝ) / (m + 1) := aux m
      simpa using this
```
